note: NVIDIA's own Bolt checkpoint as the txgsync LiLiCorr-MLX bundle (98c0cb75; NVIDIA's 24GB safetensors and LiLiCorr drafter byte-identical, plus the MLX model file nemotron_bolt.py: IQ2_XXS Metal kernels, Q8_0 transcoded exactly to MLX 8-bit g32, NVFP4 via MLX nvfp4) in oMLX 0.7.1rc1 (mlx 0.32.4, mlx-vlm 0.7.8 git 9790231 = the version the bundle is tested with). Trust Remote Code on (required). The model dir is a symlink, nothing copied. Cache flags as the Qwen oMLX configs (paged SSD 4 GB, hot 4 GB, memory guard aggressive). Thinking off via the bench's chat_template_kwargs. Drafter on as the bundle README says (oMLX settings dflash_enabled, no draft path = the bundled dflash/ folder; verify mode = oMLX default 'adaptive'). bolt/omlx_bolt_serve.sh reproduces the README's GUI flow: the model file adds Bolt to oMLX's DFlash model list on its first import, so it loads once, unloads, loads again with 'DFlash drafter attached', and only then opens the harness port (TCP forwarder to oMLX's internal port 18241). adaptive_warm: oMLX's adaptive verify state persists across requests. Measured 2026-10-18: greedy works (DFlash attached on both loads), but every T>0 request fails in oMLX's sampled DFlash selection (AttributeError: 'LiLiCorrSelector' object has no attribute 'hidden_projection'), so the T=0.6 decode, prefill and tools phases return no content.
